python_startup_audit.constraint: -S skips site; -B disables bytecode writes; -X pycache_prefix names fresh absent directory so existing pyc is not read; verify prefix remains absent.

stage_contract: Create fresh outputs exclusively; record actual exit, argv, cwd, exact environment, input/output SHA256 and stdout/stderr SHA256. Stop on mismatch or unexpected exit. Keep stdout/stderr even on failure. DB must not exist before init. Verify source, typed JSON and all immutable inputs before and after import/reimport; capture entire consumer file inventory and Git status before, after and after reimport. Verify only two reports changed and reimport identical. Preserve complete report files and all logs.

stage_runner.limitations: exclusive lock/log/receipt and absent output checks assume no external concurrent process; database and BQRS writers create their own paths.
